title: The Stack That Knows Its Minimum
statement:
Maintain a stack of integers that starts empty and supports three commands:
- `push x` puts `x` on top of the stack;
- `pop` removes the top element;
- `min` asks for the smallest element currently in the stack.

`pop` and `min` are only given when the stack is not empty. Add up the answers to all `min` commands.

## Input
The first line contains `q`, the number of commands. Each of the next `q` lines is one command in the form shown above.

## Output
Print the sum of the answers to all `min` commands, or `0` if there are none. The answer can be larger than 32 bits.

## Constraints
- `1 <= q <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= x <= 10^9`

samples.input:
6
push 3
push 1
min
pop
min
push 5
